class A { add() { return this; } }
class B extends A { y = 2; }
function f(a: A) { return a; }
f(new B());
const a: A = new B();
const bs: B[] = [];
const as: A[] = bs;
class C { add(): this { return this; } }
class D extends C { y = 2; }
const c: C = new D();
class Shape { same(o: this): boolean { return true; } }
class Sq extends Shape { s = 1; }
const x: Shape = new Sq();
interface I { m(): this }
class E implements I { m() { return this; } z = 1 }
const i: I = new E();
console.log(a, as, c, x, i);
